v6-27.candidate: then hear from heaven and be propitious toward the sins of Thy servants and Thy people Israel, for Thou wilt make known to them the good way in which they will walk. Give rain upon Thy land that Thou didst give Thy people as an inheritance.
v6-27.close: then hear from heaven and be propitious toward the sins of Thy servants and Thy people Israel, for Thou wilt make known to them the good way in which they should walk. Give rain upon Thy land that Thou didst give Thy people as an inheritance.

v6-1.display:
Then Solomon said,
“The Lord said that He would dwell in thick darkness.

v6-2.display:
I have built a house for Thy name, holy to Thee
and ready for dwelling throughout the ages.”

v6-41.display:
Now arise, O Lord God, to Thy rest,
Thou and the ark of Thy strength.
Let Thy priests, O Lord God, clothe themselves with salvation,
and let Thy sons rejoice in good things.

v6-42.display:
Lord God, do not turn away the face of Thine anointed one.
Remember the mercies of David Thy servant.”
